name: TC-142: the seeded orders are reflected in today's Daily Report KPIs
description: Deterministic proof that the report aggregates real order data: after seeding 3 CONFIRMED orders at the seed item's real price, the current business day's KPIs (from GET /restaurant/:id/daily-close?include=report) have grown by at least the seeded order count and net-sales amount vs. the pre-seed baseline. Uses >= (not ==) because other specs may add orders to the same day concurrently — they only ever increase it.
